description: Source code implementing functions for handling X509 extensions in OpenSSL, including retrieval, creation, modification, and deletion of extensions.

methods.name: X509v3_get_ext_count
methods.description: Returns the number of extensions in the stack.

methods.name: X509v3_get_ext_by_NID
methods.description: Finds extension index by NID starting from lastpos.

methods.name: X509v3_get_ext_by_OBJ
methods.description: Finds extension index by ASN1_OBJECT starting from lastpos.

methods.name: X509v3_get_ext_by_critical
methods.description: Finds extension index by critical flag starting from lastpos.

methods.name: X509v3_add_ext
methods.description: Adds a new extension at specified position.

methods.name: X509_EXTENSION_set_object
methods.description: Sets the object of an extension.

methods.name: X509_EXTENSION_set_critical
methods.description: Sets the critical flag of an extension.

methods.name: X509_EXTENSION_set_data
methods.description: Sets the data of an extension.

methods.name: X509_EXTENSION_get_object
methods.description: Retrieves the object of an extension.

methods.name: X509_EXTENSION_get_data
methods.description: Retrieves the data of an extension.

methods.name: X509_EXTENSION_get_critical
methods.description: Checks if an extension is critical.
